site_tagline: The community of cloud builders in Laos
hero_subtitle: A community of developers, students and cloud engineers in Laos. Free meetups, hands-on workshops and talks — in Lao and English.
about_body: AWS User Group Lao is a volunteer-run community for anyone interested in cloud computing. We meet regularly in Vientiane to share what we are building, learn from each other, and help newcomers get started. Everyone is welcome — no AWS experience required.
